description: This file defines a Fragment class named VehicleFragment used in an Android app. It manages a RecyclerView that displays vehicle data loaded from internal storage in JSON format, parses the data into ListItem objects, and sets the adapter for the RecyclerView.

classes.name: VehicleFragment
classes.description: An Android Fragment that displays vehicle information in a RecyclerView, loading data from internal storage and parsing JSON objects to populate the view.

methods.name: VehicleFragment.newInstance
methods.description: Static factory method to create a new instance of VehicleFragment.

methods.name: VehicleFragment.onCreateView
methods.description: Overrides Fragment's method to inflate the layout, initialize RecyclerView, and load vehicle data.

methods.name: VehicleFragment.loadData
methods.description: Reads vehicle data stored as JSON, parses it, and populates the RecyclerView with ListItem objects.
